title: Chris's reaction to anomalous metal, and only two others seen before

tellings.quote: He told me there were only he'd only ever seen two other reactions.

plain: In Zanesville, Ohio, Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs are drawn to him, is said to have reacted to a piece of unusual metal in a way that the man watching had seen only twice before. Bledsoe tells Michels this second-hand, passing on what Timothy Taylor told him: "he'd only ever seen two other reactions." If true, it would put Bledsoe in a very small group of people with an unexplained response to such material.
